name: eBooks (Self-Published, AI-Assisted)

yield.notes: Revenue from Amazon KDP, Gumroad, or Payhip. AI assistance dramatically speeds drafting.

flags: Amazon AI content disclosure policy applies
Refund rates can be high if quality is poor

startup_checklist: Research 3 niche topics where you have knowledge or can use AI effectively
Outline book structure (7-10 chapters) and draft with AI assistance
Review, edit, and add original insights or personal experience
Design cover in Canva (buyer judge heavily by cover)
Publish on KDP and/or Gumroad; price $7–$27 depending on length and niche
failure_modes: Cover or title fails to attract clicks — no sales
Poor reviews reduce discoverability on Amazon
AI-only content with no original value earns nothing
kill_criteria: Less than $50/month after 3 books published and 90 days of promotion
Amazon removes book for AI content policy violation
sources_note: Earnings estimates from KDP creator community data.
